sources.interpretation: Carbohydrate means available carbohydrate or available carbohydrate by difference.

Sum uses available sugars/starch and specified available oligomers; difference subtracts dietary fibre and listed substances including polyols. Fibre is outside the available72. Legal exclusion is not measured polyol quantity or exact manufacturer analytical method.
Individual declarations of listed components use conditions/5g threshold; no declaration does not prove absent polyols.
EU labelled carbohydrate includes polyols; distinguish EU label definition from the existing internal EU_AVAILABLE normalized field.

euComparison: AU available label maps to existing EU_AVAILABLE semantic. Unlike EU carbohydrate labels that may include polyols, this normalization requires no second subtraction. No jurisdiction enum or calculation method changed.
